verdict.rationale: New Relic AI lets users ask questions, troubleshoot, and explore telemetry in plain language, and can help fix queries. The official MCP server converts plain-English questions to NRQL, and the vulnerability agent can act on findings by opening Jira or GitHub issues. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of configuration actions (e.g. creating alerts, dashboards, or SLOs by command), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the NL experience.
